text:
mike: quick ask — can someone run a small continuous-batching sanity throughput check for the changes in PR #4821? I tweaked the small-batch fallback and max-batch heuristic. No full sweep, just a 10k-request smoke on r-mixture-7b in staging (gpu-staging-rt-3). Want a quick profile + numbers so I can decide whether to merge. pinging @jen and @devon for CR as well.

sara: on it. what loadgen flags do you want? sequence distribution?

mike: thanks — use this example:
```
./loadgen \
  --model r-mixture-7b \
  --batch-policy continuous \
  --max-batch 16 \
  --max-tokens 2048 \
  --seq-dist 64,256,1024 \
  --requests 10000 \
  --concurrency 200
```

infra-bot: provisioning requested: gpu-staging-rt-3 (3xA10). ETA ~7m.

lou: starting the run now, will stream logs to /tmp/cb-run-1767801234.log.

sara: heads-up — do you want the run with small-batch-fallback enabled or disabled? default is enabled.

mike: start with it enabled. after that, please run a second quick pass with fallback disabled (flag --small-batch-fallback=false) and also try queue_timeout_ms=10 and 30 to gauge sensitivity.

lou: first pass (fallback enabled) finished. quick numbers:
- p50 latency: 28ms
- p95 latency: 84ms
- avg throughput: 5.2k tok/s
- observed max_batch actual: 12 (rarely hit 16)

profiling snippet (top hot paths):
```
0.31s  serve.loop->batch_dispatch
0.12s  kv_cache::lookup
0.10s  attention_kernel
0.07s  batch_merge
```

sara: compared to baseline from yesterday (same config but old heuristic): p95 72ms, throughput 5.6k tok/s. looks like the new heuristic is increasing window slightly which hurts p95.

mike: ok interesting. can you post the exact config you used and the first 200 log lines? I'll glance for queueing spikes.

lou: pasted logs to /tmp/cb-run-1767801234.log and uploaded a short flame at /tmp/cb-run-1767801234.prof. config used:
```
max_batch: 16
max_tokens: 2048
queue_timeout_ms: 20
batch_delay_ms: 5
small_batch_fallback: true
```

sara: running second pass with --small-batch-fallback=false now, then queue_timeout_ms=10 and 30. will post quick diffs.

devon: I'm taking a look at PR #4821. Noticed a race in allocator_free() — leaving a small comment. otherwise code flow is fine; will approve if you add the mutex.

jen: quick CR note: please add a unit test around fallback trigger conditions. other than that LGTM.

mike: thanks both — I can add the test. devon/jenn, can you mark ready-to-merge after the smoke runs are green?

sara: results for fallback=false: p50 26ms, p95 78ms, throughput 5.35k tok/s. less variance but still ~4% throughput hit vs baseline.

sara: queue_timeout_ms=10 run: p95 76ms, throughput 5.4k.

sara: queue_timeout_ms=30 run: p95 88ms, throughput 5.1k (higher p95). seems shorter queue timeout helps a bit for p95 and throughput slightly.

lou: attaching the short profiler comparison: fallback=true vs false shows smaller batch_merge time when fallback disabled.

mike: this is super helpful. conclusion: heuristic tweak added smoothing that increases the batching window moderately; we can revert that part or tune queue_timeout to 10 by default. i'll open a follow-up to tweak heuristic and will add the unit test.

devon: approved after mutex fix. merging to staging once the follow-up issue is opened.

jen: can we add a tiny nightly quick-smoke that runs this exact 10k job for each new runtime change? name it cb-smoke-quick in perf-suite so we get early regressions.

mike: yes — i'll file PERF-2146 with steps and attach the loadgen flags. thanks all :thumbsup:

sara: great, re-run artifacts uploaded at /artifacts/cb/1767801234/*.log and /artifacts/cb/1767801234/*.prof

lou: marking thread resolved on my side. if you want deeper perf digs let me know and I can run an extended sweep.
